description: C-terminal conservation profiles across Saccharomycetaceae: AMD2 vs peroxisomal PTS1 and cytosolic benchmark proteins
code:
import requests, re, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

def fasta_parse(txt):
    out={}; k=None; b=[]
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith(">"):
            if k: out[k]="".join(b)
            k=ln[1:]; b=[]
        else: b.append(ln.strip())
    if k: out[k]="".join(b)
    return out

panel = {"AMD2":"query","MDH3":"peroxisomal PTS1","SPS19":"peroxisomal PTS1","TES1":"peroxisomal PTS1",
         "FOX2":"peroxisomal PTS1","CIT2":"peroxisomal PTS1","PEX8":"peroxisomal PTS1",
         "ADH1":"cytosolic","PGK1":"cytosolic","TDH3":"cytosolic","CDC19":"cytosolic",
         "HXK2":"cytosolic","FBA1":"cytosolic"}
ACC={}
for g in panel:
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":f"gene_exact:{g} AND organism_id:559292 AND reviewed:true",
              "fields":"accession,sequence","size":"3"},timeout=60)
    h=r.json().get("results",[])
    if h: ACC[g]=(h[0]["primaryAccession"],h[0]["sequence"]["value"]); time.sleep(0.1)

W=30
rows=[]; profiles={}
for g,cls in panel.items():
    acc,qs=ACC[g]
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
      params={"query":f"uniref_cluster_50:UniRef50_{acc} AND taxonomy_id:4893","format":"fasta"},timeout=150)
    fa=fasta_parse(r.text) if r.status_code==200 else {}
    seqs=[s for s in fa.values() if len(s)>=W]
    if len(seqs)<4: print("skip",g); continue
    # C-terminally anchored identity to the S. cerevisiae query, position -1 .. -W
    prof=[]
    for k in range(1,W+1):
        qa=qs[-k]
        prof.append(np.mean([s[-k]==qa for s in seqs]))
    prof=np.array(prof); profiles[g]=(cls,prof,len(seqs))
    tri_id=prof[:3].mean(); flank_id=prof[3:20].mean()
    rows.append(dict(gene=g,cls=cls,n=len(seqs),cterm3=qs[-3:],
                     id_pos_m1=round(prof[0],3),id_pos_m2=round(prof[1],3),id_pos_m3=round(prof[2],3),
                     tri_identity=round(tri_id,3),flank4_20_identity=round(flank_id,3),
                     ratio=round(tri_id/max(flank_id,1e-9),2)))
    time.sleep(0.2)

T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["cls","ratio"],ascending=[True,False])
pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("cterm_conservation_ratio.csv",index=False)

perox=T[T.cls=="peroxisomal PTS1"].ratio.values; cyto=T[T.cls=="cytosolic"].ratio.values
amd=T[T.gene=="AMD2"].ratio.values[0]
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(perox,cyto,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nMann-Whitney peroxisomal vs cytosolic C-term/flank identity ratio: U={u.statistic}, p={u.pvalue:.4f}")
print(f"peroxisomal ratios median={np.median(perox):.2f} (range {perox.min():.2f}-{perox.max():.2f})")
print(f"cytosolic    ratios median={np.median(cyto):.2f} (range {cyto.min():.2f}-{cyto.max():.2f})")
print(f"AMD2 ratio = {amd:.2f}  -> percentile within cytosolic set: {stats.percentileofscore(cyto,amd):.0f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
col={"peroxisomal PTS1":"#2a7fbf","cytosolic":"#9a9a9a","query":"#d1495b"}
x=np.arange(1,W+1)
for g,(cls,p,n) in profiles.items():
    axes[0].plot(x,p,color=col[cls],lw=2.4 if cls=="query" else 1.2,
                 alpha=1.0 if cls=="query" else 0.6, label=g if cls=="query" else None)
axes[0].axvspan(0.5,3.5,color="#ffd38a",alpha=0.45,zorder=0)
axes[0].set_xlabel("position from C-terminus (1 = last residue)")
axes[0].set_ylabel("fraction of Saccharomycetaceae homologs\nidentical to S. cerevisiae residue")
axes[0].set_title("C-terminal conservation profile\n(shaded: PTS1 tripeptide positions)")
axes[0].invert_xaxis(); axes[0].legend(frameon=False)
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
axes[0].legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],color=col[c],lw=2,label=c) for c in col],frameon=False,fontsize=8)

order=["peroxisomal PTS1","cytosolic"]
for i,c in enumerate(order):
    v=T[T.cls==c].ratio.values
    axes[1].scatter(np.full(len(v),i)+np.random.uniform(-.08,.08,len(v)),v,
                    color=col[c],s=55,zorder=3,edgecolor="w")
axes[1].scatter([2],[amd],color=col["query"],s=130,marker="D",zorder=4,edgecolor="w")
axes[1].set_xticks([0,1,2]); axes[1].set_xticklabels(["peroxisomal\nPTS1 (n=6)","cytosolic\n(n=6)","AMD2"])
axes[1].axhline(1.0,color="k",ls=":",lw=1)
axes[1].set_ylabel("identity(last 3 aa) / identity(positions 4-20)")
axes[1].set_title("Selection on the C-terminal tripeptide\nrelative to its own flanking region")
for s in ["top","right"]:
    axes[0].spines[s].set_visible(False); axes[1].spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
